scenario: SovereignObject constructed with parent_so_id pointing at a so_id that has no corresponding EventStream entries
expected: Undefined by current architecture — no SO registry exists to check against
note: Neither SovereignObject nor GECMediator maintains any central registry of created so_ids to validate parent_so_id against — each EventStream only knows about entries for so_ids it has actually seen. A dangling parent reference is accepted silently because there is structurally nothing to check it against yet. This mirrors GAR-EDGE-003/SDB-GAR-03 (dangling causal_parent_id) almost exactly. Logged as SDB-02 (Type II gap) — needs a Decision Record on whether a Tier 1 sample should maintain an in-memory SO registry for referential integrity checks, or whether this is deferred to a higher/storage layer.
